task_meta.title: Fix invoice totals that are off by a cent

claim_text:
The invoice calculation now follows Finance's rules. All 9 tests pass when run with `dotnet run --project tests`: the 4 that were there, of which 3 were failing before, and 5 I added.

**Why the numbers were a cent off**

There were three separate causes, one for each kind of dis
digest: Read 7 files (7 before its first edit), made 3 edits, ran tests 2 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
